entities.summary: Paolo Zuccarelli was an Italian racing driver. Zuccarelli graduated in engineering in Brescia and took on racing shortly afterwards. In 1910 he moved to France. He was among the first Europe-based racers to travel to the U.S. in 1913 to compete in the Indianapolis 500. Zuccarelli was killed while testing a car prior to the 1913 French Grand Prix at Amiens.
